name: Freshservice
description: Freshservice is an IT service-management platform for incidents, service requests, assets, changes, problems, releases, knowledge, automation, and employee support. Teams use it to run service desks and governed operational workflows.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Freshservice account domain and personal agent API key, then let selected agents use bounded ticket summaries or the documented API v2 surface under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHSERVICE_DOMAIN
credentialRequirements.label: Freshservice domain
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the account name before .freshservice.com; API v2 does not support custom CNAMEs.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHSERVICE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Freshservice API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy your personal API key from Freshservice profile settings. Its access follows your agent role.

capabilities.label: Read service tickets
capabilities.description: List bounded ticket summaries and read one exact ticket without requester contacts, conversations, attachments, custom fields, descriptions, or embedded resources.

capabilities.label: Full Freshservice API
capabilities.description: Use the documented Freshservice API v2 surface allowed by the connected agent role and personal API key.

approvalRequired.label: List service tickets
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five ticket operational summaries from the fixed first page without embeds.

approvalRequired.label: Read service ticket
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact numeric ticket through Relay's bounded operational projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Freshservice API
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Freshservice API v2 operation authorized by the connected agent API key; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded ticket reads and every broader API operation require approval; tenant binding, secret isolation, provider roles, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected API-key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; exact tenant binding, secret isolation, request bounds, audits, provider roles, and Freshservice limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted personal key only to the exact normalized freshservice.com tenant.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted personal key only to the exact normalized freshservice.com tenant.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Freshservice domain and personal agent API key are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer enters the account name before .freshservice.com and a personal agent API key, then Relay verifies exact-tenant health, bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader API behavior, key reset, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Freshservice's official API v2 reference documents HTTPS-only freshservice.com tenant endpoints, personal API-key Basic authentication, agent-role authorization, ticket APIs, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE operations, pagination, response errors, rate limits, and the lack of custom-CNAME support.
Freshservice documents its REST API as the supported interface for service-management data and workflows and directs customers to the current API reference.
Freshservice documents migration away from API v1 toward API v2, supporting Relay's fixed v2-only boundary.
